tools.name: list_taxonomy
tools.description: List the roles, tasks and sectors ToolGrail maps tools to, with slugs and canonical URLs. Results are paged per kind; there are hundreds of roles.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_taxonomy · Public sink: compare_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_taxonomy · Public sink: compare_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
